title: What happens when the local paper closes?
caption:
Fewer reporters cover local government. The Daily Nun looked at what researchers have measured when the local paper closes.

A 2026 Northwestern count found 238 U.S. counties with no locally based professional news source. Studies link closures and thinner coverage to higher public borrowing costs and less-informed voters. They show patterns, not what happens in any one town.

reel.title: Who is watching the meeting?
reel.voiceover: What happens when the local paper closes? A 2026 Northwestern count found 238 U.S. counties with no locally based professional news source. One study estimated that after a local paper closed, the town's borrowing costs went up, about six hundred fifty thousand dollars per bond issue. Another found voters with less coverage were less likely to know their representative's name. The meeting still happens. Who is watching? The Daily Nun.

sources.title: The State of Local News 2026
sources.author: Zach Metzger and John Volk
sources.publisher: Medill Local News Initiative, Northwestern University
sources.limits: Counts locally based professional outlets, not every information source. The 170 figure combines closures and mergers. Methodology changed this year. Figures from the repository's report verification of 2026-11-11 (source E08); the site returned HTTP 503 and a certificate error on 2026-11-15.

sources.title: Financing dies in darkness? The impact of newspaper closures on public finance
sources.author: Pengjie Gao, Chang Lee, Dermot Murphy
sources.limits: Publisher abstract read on RePEc on 2026-11-15; full data, sample period, and methods not reviewed. The 5-11 basis point and $650,000 figures and the causal claim are the authors' own.

sources.title: Press Coverage and Political Accountability
sources.author: James M. Snyder Jr., David Strömberg
sources.publisher: NBER Working Paper 13878; Journal of Political Economy (2010)
sources.limits: Abstract read on 2026-11-15. Concerns U.S. House coverage in earlier decades, not newspaper closures directly.

sources.title: Local News and National Politics
sources.author: Gregory J. Martin, Joshua McCrain
sources.limits: Abstract read through Crossref on 2026-11-15. Concerns one conglomerate's acquisitions of local TV stations; results are relative to other programs in the same markets.
